about: Render test cases. The cloud build runs each command on the test photo, or a picture generated from it (source: warm, negative, chart, haze, noise, moire, grid, lens, lateral-ca, fringe, fisheye, dust) (iPad simulator, -renderGallery) and dev-tools/ci_results.py checks the picture against the base case (or the case named in vs). Metrics: mean_luma, p5_luma, p25_luma, p50_luma, p75_luma, p95_luma, mean_sat, mean_r, mean_g, mean_b, diff, peak, edge (fine detail), local_contrast, fringe (colour at edges), corner_luma, center_luma. Directions: up, down, changed, same. "min" overrides the smallest change that counts.
